name: Wolf's Leap
desc: Leap to your aim and crash down, knocking foes away.

name: Iron Whirl
desc: Spin through a crowd with unbreakable footing.

name: Battle Howl
desc: +30% damage for 8 s; staggers everything close.

name: Rend
desc: A driving thrust that sets wounds burning.

name: Fire Grenade
desc: Lob a grenade at your aim point. Burns, and arcs over shields.

desc: Drop a mine that roots whatever trips it.

name: Breaker Slug
desc: A charged shot that pierces four foes and wrecks armour.
